The '''''Best Cargo''''' was a modified [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] assigned to the some [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] for a mission to [[the Graveyard]]. It was 35 meters long. It could be operated by a single person in a pinch but typically had five crew including one gunner. It carried six passengers, 150 metric tons of cargo, and two months' consumables. It had a class 1 hyperdrive and a class 15 backup. It could fly 750 kmh in atmosphere and had a [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]]. It was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turrets.
